allocation_by_value_description: Each line's share of the order's value.
allocation_by_quantity_description: Each line's share of the units.
allocation_none_description: An expense on the total only.
list_description: What you order from your suppliers, where it goes, and what has arrived.
goes_to_description: The location the goods are received at.
list_empty_description_write: Order stock from a supplier: lines start from their catalogue's prices.
list_empty_description_read: Orders placed with suppliers show here.
list_no_results_title: No purchase orders match these filters
new_subtitle: Lines, extra costs and dates come next, on its page.
new_no_suppliers: Add a supplier first: purchase orders are placed with one.
confirm_close_description: {number}: What hasn't arrived is cancelled: nothing more is expected. Received goods stay received, and carry the extra costs between them.
confirm_cancel_description: {number}: Nothing arrived on it: the supplier owes nothing, and it can't be ordered again.
confirm_delete_description: {number}: It was never ordered, so it's removed for good.
send_subtitle_draft: It's marked as ordered and emailed to the supplier.
send_subtitle_first: The order is emailed to the supplier as it is now.
send_subtitle_revision: Revision {revision, number} is emailed: what the order says now.
send_subtitle_again: The order is emailed again as it is now.
send_to_no_contact: The supplier has no contact with an email: type an address.
send_message_description: Shown above the order in this email.
lines_empty: No lines yet. Add the variants to order: prices start from the supplier's catalogue.
landed_hint: Landed: one unit's cost with its share of the extra costs, in {currency}.
landed_hint_store: Landed: one unit's cost with its share of the extra costs, in the store's currency.
remove_line_description: It's taken off this purchase order.
line_subtitle_new: How many, and at what price.
quantity_min_arrived: At least the {count, number} already arrived
unit_cost_description_change: Net of tax, up to 4 decimals past the cent.
costs_subtitle: Shipping, duties and fees, spread into each unit's landed cost.
costs_arrived_title: {count, plural, one {# unit has arrived} other {# units have arrived}}
costs_arrived_description: Changing these costs revalues what's in stock: each item's cost moves by its share of the difference, shown in its history. Units already sold keep their cost.
remove_cost_description: Its share comes out of the lines' landed costs.
remove_cost_description_stock: Its share comes out of the lines' landed costs, and out of the cost of the units in stock.
cost_dialog_subtitle: Paid to bring the goods in, besides their price.
cost_paid_in_description: Duties paid at home are often in the store's currency.
tax_subtitle: On the total only: purchase tax is in no unit's cost.
exchange_rate_description: Up to 8 decimals. Each receipt keeps the rate it used.
their_reference_description: The supplier's own number for the order.
note_to_supplier_description: Printed and emailed with the order.
details_dialog_subtitle: Where it goes, when it's due, and what the supplier reads.
received_untracked_subtitle: Some of it had no stock record, so one was made, untracked: whether it sells didn't change.
received_track_hint: Track their stock to sell only what's on hand.
receive_dialog_subtitle: Accepted units go on hand at their landed cost; refused ones are only counted.
receive_still_to_come: {outstanding, number} of {quantity, number} still to come
receive_over_description: {lines}: the supplier sent more than is still to come. Receive it anyway?
